symptom: The fourth CE call added two test artifacts, but the composed portfolio failed cross-task production/test behavior coverage and then projected a misleading advisory-fallback terminal code.

exact_run_evidence.preserved_provider_error: shared_behavior_contract behavior invariant lacks cross-task production-and-test obligation coverage: test_owner=TASK-3

root_cause.confirmed: Pre-freeze validation reported only the test-file depth deficit. Its diagnosis authorized only artifact_upsert. Adding PM-authorized TASK-3 test artifacts then created a behavior-coverage obligation that could not be repaired in the same envelope, while the call budget was already exhausted. The prompt also incorrectly required behavior covered ids to pre-exist, even though the composer safely validates references after atomic merge.

fix.policy: A test_files depth diagnosis also authorizes the cross-task behavior invariant and task-ref operations required for the newly introduced test owner. Behavior coverage may reference an existing completion id or an artifact id introduced in the same atomic patch; the composer validates the merged closure before acceptance.
